concerns.text: The plan assumes that full inference (including multiple sparsity configurations) and gradient‑based attribution can be completed on the free‑tier GitHub Actions CPU runner (2 cores, ≤ 7 GB RAM) within a 6 h wall‑clock limit. Running the LocateAnything model (≈ 1 B parameters) on CPU for ~2 k dense images across 4–5 sparsity levels plus a ±8‑patch sweep is unlikely to finish within this budget; empirical estimates suggest runtimes well beyond 6 h, making the compute plan infeasible under the stated resource constraints.
